profit_quality.assessment: Do not use reported net profit as the denominator. 2024 reported profit of HK$6.478m included HK$6.981m bank interest income, while operating profit was only HK$1.342m and 2024 free cash flow after PPE/intangible purchases was about negative HK$0.432m. Main denominator uses the three-year median operating-profit signal, then applies a 0.50 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Excluded bank interest income from the operating profit denominator.
Used recent three-year operating profit history: 2022 HK$-0.685m, 2023 HK$9.687m, 2024 HK$1.342m; median HK$1.342m.
2024 operating cash flow HK$6.878m minus PPE/intangible purchases HK$7.310m gives slightly negative post-capex free cash flow; this supports a large cash-profit haircut.
Ordinary operating lease liabilities are reflected through ongoing operating burden and cash-profit quality rather than deducted as financing debt.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2022/2023 operating cash flow was strong, but 2024 deteriorated to HK$6.878m and post-capex free cash flow was slightly negative. Three-year evidence supports positive but thin main-business cash generation.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Recent operating profit is volatile and 2024 reported profit is mainly bank interest; 2024 post-capex cash generation is weak, so only 50% of the pre-haircut operating-profit denominator is treated as sustainable distributable cash profit.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2024 CFO/reported net profit was about 1.06x, but reported net profit is not the right operating denominator because finance income exceeded operating profit.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2024 PPE plus intangible purchases were HK$7.310m; annual report does not split maintenance and growth capex, so this is treated as a pressure point.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working-capital movements reduced cash by about HK$1.423m before tax, mainly from inventory increase, contract liabilities decline and accrual/payables decline partly offset by trade payables increase.
